displayPattern: Status LED: 3 short flashes then 2 long flashes (Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump and 24VNA9 air conditioner; amber status LED on the outdoor control)
meaning: Low pressure trip: the control elevates to fault 83 (low pressure lockout) after 3 occurrences. Reset time is 6 minutes.
causes: The manual says to refer to fault 83 for causes: closed service valve, undercharged system, low indoor (cooling) or outdoor (heating) airflow, EXV or TXV problems, restriction in the filter drier or circuits
diySteps: In cooling mode, check the indoor coil for clogging by ice or debris and clean or de-ice it if necessary (the manual also says to troubleshoot the indoor fan motor)
Check the outdoor coil for clogging by ice or debris and clean or de-ice it if necessary (the manual also says to troubleshoot the outdoor fan motor)
Technician: follow the fault 83 table (service valves, charge, expansion device, filter drier)
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 32 repeats or escalates to 83.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
